title: Video2World: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive World Modeling from Embodied Videos
abstract: arXiv:2610.04432v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations is a promising way to scale embodied data, but current pipelines still rely heavily on manual environment construction and calibration. We study whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can automate this process end to end. We formulate \emph{autonomous video-to-simulation} as a software engineering task in which an agent observes an embodied video, constructs the corresponding simulated environment and robot behavior, and iteratively refines the result through execution feedback. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{Video2World}, a benchmark comprising 222 reconstruction instances derived from 189 robot and human demonstration videos. Video2World measures reconstructed worlds along geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness, capturing spatial perception, physical reasoning, and executable interaction. translated_title: Video2World：基于具身视频的交互式世界建模编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 从真实世界观测中构建交互式模拟器是扩展具身数据的一条有前景的途径，但当前的流水线仍然严重依赖人工环境构建与校准。我们研究了前沿基础模型和编码智能体能否端到端地自动化这一过程。我们将“自主视频到模拟”表述为一项软件工程任务：智能体观察一段具身视频，构建相应的模拟环境与机器人行为，并通过执行反馈迭代地优化结果。为评估这一能力，我们提出了 Video2World，这是一个包含 222 个重建实例的基准，这些实例源自 189 段机器人与人类演示视频。Video2World 从几何保真度、动态保真度和功能正确性三个维度衡量重建的世界，涵盖空间感知、物理推理和可执行交互。对 9 个前沿（模型）的评估……
tldr: 该论文提出了 Video2World 基准，将“从具身视频端到端自动构建交互式模拟环境”形式化为软件工程任务，利用 222 个来自机器人和人类演示视频的重建实例，从几何保真度、动态保真度和功能正确性三方面评估前沿基础模型与编码智能体的自主世界建模能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Video2World, a benchmark of 222 reconstruction instances from 189 robot and human demonstration videos that formulates autonomous video-to-simulation as a software engineering task, evaluating whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can end-to-end build interactive simulated worlds measured by geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness.
